output.summary: A deciduous tree native from China through Southeast Asia to the Indian subcontinent, the orchid tree bears conspicuous pink or white flowers. Its mature pods twist into corkscrews and burst open with an audible clack. In South Asia, its edible buds are cooked in curries, stir-fried or pickled, while flowers and buds make Nepalese pickles.
output.edibilityNote: Buds are cooked in curries, stir-fried or pickled across South Asia; flowers and buds are used in Nepalese pickles.
